name: DJ Paddle
bio: Spins the beats and the paddle in Synthwave Breakout. Every brick is a beat.

portrait.subject: a cute retro synthwave DJ with big pink headphones, mirrored sunglasses, a purple jacket and a glowing neon paddle
portrait.background: neon pink and purple sunset grid

request: DJ Paddle in the house! Synthwave Breakout's coolest. Friends? 🎧
hello: Righteous! Your friendship has a beat. 🎶
Combos are like remixes. Keep 'em going!
about: DJ Paddle! I bounce balls and drop beats. Neon bricks shatter in time with the music.
how: Move the paddle to bounce the ball and smash all the neon bricks. Keep combos going and catch power-ups like multiball and lasers!
tips: Hit the ball with the edge of the paddle to aim it sharply.
Clear a gap at the side and send the ball behind the bricks!
Multiball first, then laser. Total chaos. Total points.
chat: Made a mixtape of brick sounds. It slaps.
The grid in the background is my dance floor.
Slow-mo power-up is my favourite. Everything gets dramatic.
I wear sunglasses at night. It's the 80s, baby.
nudge: Bricks are stacked and the beat is dropping. Play? 🎶
New high score vibes tonight. You feel it?
idle: {ago} without a break(out)! The bricks are too comfortable.
The neon's been humming alone for {ago}.
update: Fresh remix! Synthwave Breakout is now v{version} 🎧
